unchanged_from_v1.retry_policy: one initial generation; one retry only if the output does not parse into schema v1, with the parser error shown. No retry for wrong, weak, incomplete or abstaining answers. Transport retries (at most 2) re-send a request only when no response was received.

context_serializer.truncation: headline first 300 characters, excerpt first 500 characters

pre_generation_validation: every context item passes the question's filters
frozen retriever code and index unchanged
empty context: deterministic system abstention, no provider call

changes.what: no model-written summary; the displayed answer is the validated claims joined by code
changes.why: v1 q013: the summary added 'hair', which its citations did not support (UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM)
changes.choice: removal chosen over a 'summary may add nothing' rule, because no deterministic check can verify that a free-text summary adds no fact

changes.what: coverage instructions (read every item, represent each distinct relevant finding, group items that support the same finding, cite nothing irrelevant); citations per claim raised from 5 to 10; the cap of 4 claims is kept
changes.why: v1 q013: PARTIAL, with 5 relevant context items left out (GENERATION_OMISSION); grouping needs more citations per claim

changes.what: limitations become {text, supporting_item_ids}; a limitation about a specific item must cite it and is reviewed like a claim; a limitation about the evidence set as a whole cites nothing
changes.why: v1 q013: a limitation stated an uncited fact about item 1363 (LIMITATION_UNCITED_FACT)

post_generation_validation: as v1, over claims and cited limitations

human_rubric.claim_support: each claim, and each limitation that cites items: SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNSURE
human_rubric.limitation_uncited: each limitation that cites nothing: does it state a fact about a specific item? NO / YES / UNSURE
human_rubric.reviewer_notes: optional free-text note on any task (unsupported detail, citation mismatch, omission, overstatement, causal overreach, other); qualitative only, never a metric input
human_rubric.regression_probe: q013 only, separate deck and log: for each v1 failure FIXED / RECURRED / CHANGED_FORM / UNSURE; descriptive, never part of fresh metrics

metrics.claim_support_precision: SUPPORTED / (SUPPORTED + UNSUPPORTED) over claims and cited limitations; UNSURE separate
metrics.grounded_answer_rate: as v1 (claims replace claims + summary); comparable with v1
metrics.uncited_item_specific_limitations: count of uncited limitations judged YES; reported separately, as in v1
metrics.scope: fresh DEV questions only; the q013 probe is excluded

failure_taxonomy.categories: the 13 v1 categories, plus LIMITATION_UNCITED_FACT (a post-hoc extension in v1, now pre-registered: an uncited limitation judged YES)
failure_taxonomy.notes: CITATION_MISMATCH, OVERSTATEMENT, CAUSAL_OVERREACH and CONTRADICTION_HANDLING_FAILURE can now be assigned from reviewer notes
